thesis: This episode argues that Copart (CPRT) is a high-quality, long-term leader in the salvage industry with structural advantages over competitors like IAA, including land ownership and international strength, while dismissing autonomous driving as a distant threat. It also highlights value propositions in parts industries (Copa, HICO) and notes Year's dominance in commercial aviation leasing.
